headline: Bloomberg: Tesla Robotaxi Fleet Totals Just 59 Vehicles Despite Musk Promises — comprehensive critical feature traces history of missed autonomy timelines from Jul 2025 earnings call; Musk had promised 'half the US population' with autonomous ride-hailing by end of 2025; 59 total unsupervised vehicles across Austin, Dallas, Houston; TSLA -1.43% today, daily range $384.24–$418.50, with Bloomberg coverage and SpaceX merger anxiety both weighing on sentiment (Bloomberg, Jun 10, 2026)

SpaceX-Tesla merger speculation surges — Wedbush's Dan Ives puts odds at 80%+, Fortune models a combined $3.4T entity; SpaceX IPO filing contains merger clues and $3.75B insider windfall; TSLA fell 1.43% on June 10 as investor concern mounts about dilution risk and regulatory complexity; Morningstar flags SpaceX defense contracts + Tesla China operations as potential blockade (Wedbush / Fortune / Morningstar)

Tesla expands unsupervised Robotaxi to entire Austin metro area — full city now bookable for the first time since launch; however only ~20 active vehicles operating vs the full metro map; expansion happened in two stages on June 3 morning; service confirmed for both day and evening hours (Electrek / notateslaapp)

Tesla FSD (Supervised) officially launches in China on May 21 — Tesla's X account confirmed FSD Supervised is now available to Chinese customers, one week after Musk's Beijing visit with Trump; follows years of delays; opens 1M+ GigaShanghai-built eligible vehicles; subscription-only model (one-time purchase globally discontinued Feb 2026); full unsupervised clearance still pending (CNBC / CnEVPost / SCMP)

Trump-Xi Beijing summit goes LIVE May 13 with Musk + Jensen Huang on Air Force One — first US presidential China visit in nearly a decade; Trump urging Xi to 'open up' China to US business; Musk the only Tesla CEO ever to accompany a US President to Beijing; for Tesla, FSD approval remains the primary negotiation objective — China is Tesla's largest untapped FSD subscriber market; Nvidia chip export regime, rare earth supply chains, and AI governance also on the agenda; summit runs May 13–15 with markets watching for breakthrough or disappointment; TSLA pre-market +0.24% at $434.50 as summit optimism partially offsets prior session decline (Financial Express / BBC / Reuters)

Tesla FSD gains new European foothold — Ireland's Department of Transport confirms active engagement with Tesla and the National Standards Authority of Ireland (NSAI) ahead of potential FSD Supervised approval; follows Netherlands (April) and Sweden (April) greenlights; Tesla targeting broader EU deployment 'as early as summer 2026'; harmonized EU-wide clearance requires 15/27 member states — next Technical Committee vote: July 2026 (Teslarati / RTE)

Austin robotaxi unsupervised ride rate hits 66.7% — 28 of 42 rides in last 7 days with no safety driver; 50 active rider vehicles + 38 Cybercabs in test fleet; up from 59.0% on May 8 and 27.8% on May 6; fleet now operating unsupervised during evening hours for first time; pace of autonomous operational maturity accelerating sharply; three-week trajectory: 27.8% → 59.0% → 66.7% (robotaxitracker.com / Teslarati)

Tesla China retail sales -10% YoY in April (25,956 units) — domestic retail -15% YoY; the widely-reported +36% 'surge' was wholesale/export-inflated (Giga Shanghai output including European and APAC exports, NOT Chinese consumer purchases); Q1 2026 China retail was -16% YoY with January alone crashing -45%; on current trajectory, Tesla risks falling behind Xiaomi in China market share by end of 2026; bear signal directly contradicting the China delivery recovery thesis (Electrek / CnEVPost)
